module.purpose: Manages synchronization state and operations for a collection, handling sync lifecycle, pending transactions, and metadata during data synchronization from external sources.
module.summary: The CollectionSyncManager orchestrates synchronization for database collections, managing the complete lifecycle from initialization through data loading, transaction handling, and cleanup. It supports both eager and on-demand synchronization modes, tracks pending operations, handles optimistic updates, and provides metadata management APIs. The class integrates with collection state, lifecycle, and event managers to coordinate complex sync workflows while maintaining data consistency and providing robust error handling.
module.businessContext: Enables real-time data synchronization between local collections and external data sources (APIs, databases, etc.). Failure breaks data consistency and prevents applications from maintaining up-to-date local data caches.
